_readme: Copy this file to server.json and edit it, then: py -3.12 tools\nexlab\nexserver.py --config server.json. Every key is optional; without a config file the server behaves exactly like the lab one (127.0.0.1, auth 60000, secure 60001, NAT check on the loopback aliases, identities from online_identity.ini next to the game).
_readme_public: Public server: mode=public, listen=0.0.0.0, advertise=<the IP players reach>, natcheck=true with TWO different public IPs (nncs1/nncs2, each on UDP 10025 and 10125; one IP is not enough, Pretendo says the same), or natcheck=false until those two IPs exist. Registration is CLOSED by default: use "registration": "token" behind a TLS reverse proxy. Players register once: py -3.12 tools\nexlab\register.py --server https://<server> --token <secret>
